title: Trakanon (Seasonal)
summary: Trakanon alternates close-range bile, random deathgaze and a banishment of his leading target.
overview: Trakanon alternates close-range bile, random deathgaze and a banishment of his leading target.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Arrange a tank handoff when the current target is banished and keep healers ready for simultaneous damage.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Bile bursts every 20 seconds within 70 range; deathgaze checks a random hate target every 40 seconds.
Every 30 seconds, the leading client or pet owner is moved away and reduced to minimal hate.
At 20% health, scripted timers stop and several slashing, piercing and blunt attacks gain increased damage taken.

notes: Approval E286. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
